pr_title: Move logic for saving project features to ProjectSettings save_custom
pr_body: Hotfix for #31171 that only showed up on at-least-somewhat-complex projects. The old code written by over-2-years-ago-me was just badly designed code. It was saving on load, and there were two places where it tried to do this. I shouldn't have trusted myself. #31171 appears fine if it's only tested for a short time, but breaks down in any complex situation. This PR should make it work much better. Testing appreciated. Bugsquad edit: Fix #55302
pr_comments: @Chaosus Yes, it should be. I'd appreciate testing on this PR though.

review_comments: That's a good change but I'd have left it out of this PR to focus on the save fix (my mistake for commenting in the wrong context). I can see more places which currently rely on `get_safe_dir_name` to sanitize `application/config/name` - e.g. `OS_Unix::get_user_data_dir()` - so it would be worth refactoring them all in a dedicated PR).
But OK it's probably late for you on Thanksgiving's eve, so we can also merge this as is and do further tweaks (such as exposing this to scripting, and using in more places) in a follow-up PR later.
